flora: Mature Kauri Pillars (massive, perfectly straight trunks with no lower branches)
Lush fern undergrowth (forming a green carpet at the base)
Scattered mounds of resin (gum) at the base of the trunks
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; massive scale—the trunks should look like living columns; clean and airy forest floor; ancient, majestic atmosphere.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view looking down a 'hallway' of massive Kauri trunks. The ground is ochre-tinted earth. The trunks are silver-grey and perfectly straight, disappearing into a high, dark green canopy. Small mounds of amber-colored resin are visible at the base of the trees.
visual_logic.ground: Hard-packed ochre clay soil with dark grey stones and a light dusting of leaf litter.
visual_logic.lighting: Cinematic sunlight streaming from high above, illuminating the silver bark and creating a 'cathedral' effect within the grove.
